request.style: English, deep male voice, solo with gospel choir, electric guitar, upright bass, piano, drums, mournful and hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Remember the days when light broke through
You endured the hard struggle and pain
Publicly exposed to the world's view
Side by side with the ones in chains

[Pre-Chorus]
Suffered with the prisoners in the dark
Accepted the loss of what was yours
Joyfully took the seizure of your mark
Knowing your treasure is far more secure

[Chorus]
So do not throw away your confidence now
It carries a great reward for your soul
You need endurance to hold your ground
Until you receive what God foretold

[Verse]
You had a better and lasting possession
Not things that decay or fade away
But a hope that stands in its session
While the world turns and shifts its day

[Pre-Chorus]
Do not let your spirit shrink back
My soul takes no pleasure in fear
The one who is coming will not lack
And will not delay in coming here

[Chorus]
So do not throw away your confidence now
It carries a great reward for your soul
You need endurance to hold your ground
Until you receive what God foretold

[Bridge]
My righteous one will live by faith
Not among those who shrink and are destroyed
But preserving the soul in this age
With the promise of life as our joy

[Chorus]
So do not throw away your confidence now
It carries a great reward for your soul
You need endurance to hold your ground
Until you receive what God foretold

[Outro]
Hold fast to the faith
It will not be lost in the dark
Hold fast to the faith
